an5.166:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi . . . pe . . . 2.
an5.166:1.2: Idhāvuso bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:1.4: no ce diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya, atikkamm'eva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:2.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Udāyi āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca
an5.166:2.2: ‘aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso Sāriputta anavakāso, yaṃ so bhikkhu atikkamm'eva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:3.1: Dutiyam pi kho . . . tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi
an5.166:3.2: ‘idhāvuso bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:3.4: no ce diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya, atikkamm'eva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:4.1: Tatiyaṃ pi kho āyasmā Udāyi āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca
an5.166:4.2: ‘aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso Sāriputta anavakāso, yaṃ so bhikkhu atikkamm'eva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:5.1: Atha kho āyasmato Sāriputtassa etad ahosi ‘yāva tatiyam
an5.166:5.2: pi kho me āyasmā Udāyi paṭikkosati, na ca me koci bhikkhu anumodati,
an5.166:5.3: yan nūnāhaṃ yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkameyyan 'ti.
an5.166:5.4: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an5.166:5.5: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi
an5.166:5.6: ‘idhāvuso bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:5.8: no ce diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya, atikkamm'eva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:6.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Udāyi āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca
an5.166:6.2: ‘aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso Sāriputta anavakāso, yaṃ so bhikkhu atikkamm'eva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:7.1: Dutiyam pi kho. . . . tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi
an5.166:7.2: ‘idhāvuso bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:7.4: no ce diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya, atikkamm'eva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:8.1: Tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Udāyi āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca
an5.166:8.2: ‘aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso Sāriputta anavakāso, yaṃ so bhikkhu atikkamm'eva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:9.1: Atha kho āyasmato Sāriputtassa etad ahosi
an5.166:9.2: ‘Bhagavato pi kho me sammukhā āyasmā Udāyi yāva tatiyaṃ paṭikkosati, na ca me koci bhikkhu anumodati,
an5.166:9.4: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto tuṇhī ahosi.
an5.166:10.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Udāyiṃ āmantesi
an5.166:10.2: ‘kaṃ pana tvaṃ Udāyi manomayaṃ kāyaṃ paccesī' ti?
an5.166:10.3: ‘Ye te bhante devā arūpino saññāmayā' ti.
an5.166:10.4: ‘Kiṃ nu kho tuyhaṃ Udāyi bālassa avyattassa bhaṇitena
an5.166:10.5: tvam pi nāma bhaṇitabbaṃ maññasī' ti? 5.
an5.166:11.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi
an5.166:11.2: ‘atthi nāma Ānanda theraṃ bhikkhuṃ vihesiyamānaṃ ajjhupekkhissatha,
an5.166:11.3: na hi nāma Ānanda kāruññaṃ pi bhavissati theramhi bhikkhumhi vihesiyamānamhī' ti.
an5.166:12.2: ‘idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:12.4: no ce diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya, atikkamm'eva kabaliṅkārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyya pi vuṭṭhaheyya pi,
an5.166:12.7: idaṃ vatvā Sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi. 6.
an5.166:13.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando acirapakkantassa Bhagavato yenāyasmā Upavāno ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Upavānaṃ etad avoca
an5.166:13.4: Anacchariyaṃ kho pan'etaṃ āvuso Upavāna, yaṃ Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito etad eva ārabbha udāhareyya, yathā āyasmantaṃ yev'ettha Upavānaṃ paṭibhāseyya.
an5.166:13.6: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yen' upaṭṭhānasālā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Upavānaṃ etad avoca
an5.166:14.1: ‘katīhi nu kho Upavāna dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā' ti?
an5.166:14.2: Pañcahi bhante dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca.
an5.166:14.4: Idha bhante thero bhikkhu sīlavā hoti . . . pe . . . samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu,
an5.166:14.6: kalyāṇavāco hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā,
an5.166:14.7: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an5.166:14.8: āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an5.166:14.9: Imehi kho bhante pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā ti. 9.
an5.166:15.2: Imehi kho Upavāna pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca.
an5.166:15.3: Ime ce Upavāna pañca dhammā therassa bhikkhuno na saṃvijjeyyuṃ, kena naṃ sabrahmacārī sakkareyyuṃ garukareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyuṃ khaṇḍiccena pāliccena valittacatāya?
an5.166:15.4: Yasmā ca kho Upavāna ime pañca dhammā therassa bhikkhuno saṃvijjanti, tasmā taṃ sabrahmacārī sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjentī
